display.purpose: The remaining-month figure and hero source amount; Funnel Display 650, tracking -0.04em.

headline.purpose: Priority amounts, balances and stat values; tabular figures.

label.purpose: Captions, field labels, shares and pills.

shadows.name: lifted
shadows.purpose: Hero, stat strip, today's raised figure.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Hover, colour and press transitions (0.12 to 0.15s).

motion.name: terrace-rise
motion.value: spring stiffness 70, damping 16, 0.08s stagger per priority
motion.purpose: Terraces rise in priority order on load and plan change.

motion.name: water-draw
motion.purpose: The water path and channel draw along the hillside. Zero duration under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single water-blue pill for the main action of a view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #17648a; color: #fff; font: 600 15px 'Funnel Sans Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), transform .12s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #11506f; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #17648a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet sunken-stone pill for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #e4e3db; color: #1d1c19; font: 600 15px 'Funnel Sans Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #e4e3db 86%, #1d1c19); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #17648a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Stone Slab
components.description: Chalk panel with worn-stone uneven corners, no border.
components.css: .ds-slab { padding: 28px; border-radius: 44px 20px 36px 14px / 18px 36px 20px 40px; background: #f9f9f5; color: #1d1c19; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(40 34 24 / .07); font: 400 15px/1.5 'Funnel Sans Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-slab h3 { margin: 0 0 6px; font: 650 20px/1.25 'Funnel Display Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-slab p { margin: 0; color: #45423c; }

components.name: Water Hero
components.description: Deep acequia-blue field with the headline figure; tokens remap locally.
components.css: .ds-hero { padding: 28px; border-radius: 44px 34px 48px 30px / 34px 48px 30px 44px; background: #0e4763; color: #f2f5f3; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .08), 0 1px 2px rgb(40 34 24 / .06), 0 10px 28px -12px rgb(40 34 24 / .18); font-family: 'Funnel Sans Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-hero span { display: block; font-size: 13px; color: #cddde4; } .ds-hero strong { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font: 650 56px/1 'Funnel Display Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.035em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Sunken-stone input with a blue focus line and wash halo.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font: 13px 'Funnel Sans Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #45423c; } .ds-field input { height: 46px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #d8d6cc; border-radius: 14px; background: #e4e3db; color: #1d1c19; font: inherit; font-size: 15px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; transition: border-color .15s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), box-shadow .15s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #656157; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #17648a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #d6e7ef; }

components.name: Crop Pill
components.description: Soft crop tint with matching ink; shown here in orange (para ti).
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 3px 11px; border-radius: 999px; background: #fbe3d0; color: #954207; font: 550 12px/1.5 'Funnel Sans Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Terrace Bar
components.description: Hatched dry-earth track with a lipped crop fill.
components.css: .ds-track { display: block; height: 12px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 2px 6px 2px 2px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, rgb(101 97 87 / .14) 0 4px, rgb(101 97 87 / .3) 4px 5.5px); } .ds-fill { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: 2px 6px 2px 2px; background: #3d8541; box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .14); }

components.name: Floating Tab Bar
components.description: Phone navigation: raised stone bar, current item a water-blue tile.
components.html: ResumenDia a diaPresupuesto
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 6px; border-radius: 26px 22px 26px 22px / 22px 26px 22px 26px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgb(40 34 24 / .08), 0 30px 64px -18px rgb(40 34 24 / .32); font-family: 'Funnel Sans Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 48px; height: 48px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 20px 16px 20px 16px / 16px 20px 16px 20px; color: #45423c; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 550; } .ds-tab-active { background: #17648a; color: #fff; font-weight: 650; }

narrative.overview:
The salary is water let into a Valencian hillside in its turn. It irrigates four terraces in a fixed order (expenses, you, emergency fund, investment), and the month is drawn as that cascade: each terrace's length is its exact share of net income, and water drops from lip to lip. The ground is lime-washed chalk and stone-black ink. Acequia blue carries water and every action. Surfaces are hand-cut slabs with uneven corners and no hairline borders.

The system is organic and modern, calm and dense with figures, not decorative. Numbers are large Funnel Display; everything else is quiet Funnel Sans. One deep blue hero field anchors Overview; everything else is a stone slab on chalk. It rejects the balance-card-plus-donut default and the earlier sage-forest calm.
keyCharacteristics: Four crop colours own whole regions, always in the same order.
Dry, unassigned ground is hatched, never hidden.
Worn-stone radii: every slab has the same unevenly cut corners.
Depth from warm downward shadows and tonal steps, not borders.
Signature motion: terraces rise, the water path draws in priority order.
Light, dark and system themes share one token set.

rules.name: The Crop Order Rule
rules.body: Stone, orange, rice, crop green, always in that order, always the same meaning. A priority never changes colour between screens.

rules.name: The Water Means Act Rule
rules.body: Blue is for actions, income and links. It never stands in for a crop.

rules.name: The Drought Rule
rules.body: Red appears only for a real deficit, failed save or destructive action, never as decoration or a mere warning tone.

rules.name: The Tint-and-Ink Rule
rules.body: On a crop tint, text uses that crop's -ink, not the base hue.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Any number a user compares (amounts, shares, terrace labels) sets font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: Display-face figures carry negative tracking between -0.02em and -0.04em, larger figures tighter.

rules.name: The Warm Downhill Rule
rules.body: Shadows are warm-tinted and fall downward; no hard offsets, no coloured glows.

rules.name: The Uneven Slab Rule
rules.body: Use the three named radius tokens for surfaces; never a uniform corner on a slab.

dos: Do colour priorities in the fixed order stone, orange, rice, crop green everywhere they appear.
Do use Acequia Blue for actions, income and links, and let the primary button be the single blue pill per view.
Do build surfaces from --radius-hero, --radius-slab, --radius-tile; use pills for controls.
Do show unassigned or unspent ground as hatched, and show deficits in Drought Red.
Do set money in Funnel Display 650 with negative tracking and tabular numerals.
Do place components in the hero with the remapped tokens rather than hard-coded hero colours.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion for every terrace and path animation.
donts: Don't use red for anything but a real deficit, failed save or destructive action.
Don't use blue as a crop colour or a crop colour as an action colour.
Don't wrap slabs in hairline borders or use hard offset or coloured shadows.
Don't fall back to the balance-card-plus-donut pattern or the sage-forest palette of the discarded world.
Don't read crop hues as text on their own tint; use the -ink variant.
Don't reintroduce the compass dial; the compass brand mark (brand-mark component, favicon) is the only compass.
